# nxos_vrrp (Data Source)

This data source can read the VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) version 2 configuration on NX-OS devices, including VRRP interfaces and group settings such as addresses, priority, preemption, authentication, BFD and object tracking.

### API Documentation

- [vrrpEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Entity/)
- [vrrpInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Inst/)
- [vrrpInterface](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Interface/)
- [vrrpId](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Id/)
- [vrrpSecondary](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Secondary/)
- [vrrpTrack](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:Track/)
- [vrrpObjectTrack](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:ObjectTrack/)
- [vrrpNativeTrack](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Routing%20and%20Forwarding/vrrp:NativeTrack/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_vrrp" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `control` (String) The control state.
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of VRRP interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `groups` (Attributes Map) List of VRRP groups.
  - Map key: `group_id` - VRRP Id.
  - Key range: `1`-`255` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--groups))
- `name` (String) The name of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.groups`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) Admin state.
- `advertisement_interval` (Number) Advertisement Interval.
- `authentication_text` (String, Sensitive) Authentication Text.
- `authentication_text_wo` (String) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `authentication_text_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `authentication_type` (String) Authentication Type.
- `bfd_peer_address` (String) BFD Peer address.
- `forwarding_lower_threshold` (Number) Fowarding Lower Threshold.
- `forwarding_upper_threshold` (Number) Forwarding Upper Threshold.
- `preempt` (String) Preempt.
- `primary_address` (String) primary IP address.
- `priority` (Number) Configured Priority.
- `secondary_addresses` (Attributes Map) List of secondary addresses of the VRRP group.
  - Map key: `address` - Secondary IP address for the VRRP Router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--groups--secondary_addresses))
- `track_interface` (String) Interface to be tracked by this VRRP instance Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.
- `track_priority` (Number) VRRP Priority when track is down.
- `tracked_objects` (Attributes Map) List of objects tracked by the VRRP group.
  - Map key: `id` - Track Id to be tracked.
  - Key range: `1`-`512` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--groups--tracked_objects))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--groups--secondary_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.groups.secondary_addresses`


<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--groups--tracked_objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces.groups.tracked_objects`

Read-Only:

- `decrement_priority` (Number) Value to be decremented from priority when tracked object is down.
